earnings.title: HP Inc. Reports Fiscal 2026 Full Year and Fourth Quarter Results; Announces Dividend Increase
highlights: Fiscal 2026 GAAP diluted net earnings per share ("EPS") of $2.62, inclusive of tariff refunds, and down 1.1% from the prior year period
Fiscal 2026 non-GAAP diluted net EPS of $3.33, inclusive of tariff refunds, and up 6.7% from the prior year period
Fiscal 2026 net revenue of $60.5 billion, up 9.5% from the prior year period
Fourth quarter GAAP diluted net EPS of $0.84, inclusive of tariff refunds, and flat from the prior year period
Fiscal 2026 net cash provided by operating activities of $4.0 billion, free cash flow of $3.3 billion

quotes.text: In the fourth quarter, we continued to grow our higher-value businesses, with AI PCs reaching nearly 60% of shipments, while taking steps to address memory and storage cost pressures.
quotes.by: Bruce Broussard, Interim CEO, HP Inc

quotes.text: We grew FY26 revenue 9.5%, delivered on our guidance for the year, exceeded our free cash flow target and returned $2.3 billion to shareholders, despite a challenging environment.

outlook: Both GAAP and non-GAAP diluted net EPS included a $0.26 favorable impact from tariff refunds, as compared to the $0.19 impact included in the previously provided outlook.
Both GAAP and non-GAAP diluted net EPS included a $0.15 favorable impact from tariff refunds, as compared to the $0.08 impact included in the previously provided outlook.
With this change the Company expects a non-GAAP tax rate of 17% based on current tax laws.
For the fiscal 2027 first quarter, HP estimates non-GAAP diluted net EPS to be in the range of $0.66 to $0.76.
